description: This file contains a Kotlin class implementing the TopicsRepository interface with an offline-first approach, primarily reading from local storage and synchronizing with a remote network source.

classes.name: OfflineFirstTopicsRepository
classes.description: A class implementing offline-first data fetching and synchronization logic for topics, with local storage as primary data source and network synchronization.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Returns a flow of list of topics mapped from database entities to external models.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns a flow of a single topic identified by its ID, mapped from database entity to external model.

methods.name: syncWith
methods.description: Performs synchronization with remote data source, updating local database with changed topics based on change list versioning.
